name: BACH_0021
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (81%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs Benign · Careful review

Invasive probability is about 0% [F1], but the conformal set cannot separate Normal from Benign.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 81%, Normal 14%, InSitu 6%, Invasive 0% | Benign leads clearly |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (90% level) | Two classes inseparable |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.955 / 94th percentile | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 1 of 5 Benign [F5] | Weak neighbor support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 0, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; spot check 0/20 [F2] · Unreliable
- **Mitotic figures** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Scored below typical; does not favor invasion [F4] · Unreliable
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Scored slightly below typical; mildly lowers invasive term · Validated
- **Neoplastic nuclei** (region 6) · context · 20 of 61 nuclei neoplastic; count flagged insufficient · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deleting the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007): not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules, mitoses Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Only regions 0, 6, 11 were segmented, and tumor-nuclei count was flagged insufficient.
- Only 1 of 5 similar cases is Benign; three are Normal, one InSitu.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 8**: look for two-layered lobules; this concept failed its spot check.
2. **Region 6**: look for atypical cells within ducts; 20 nuclei were called neoplastic.
3. **Region 7**: verify mitoses and lymphocytes by eye; both scores are weak or unreliable.
